profile.headline: Software Engineer Sr. at Lockheed Martin | Skunk Works

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and modify back-end service applications that process UCI messages that allow for intercommunication.
Continuous integration on modular open mission systems development using agile software development.
Communicate with customers and collaborate with other teams in the pursuit of accomplishing the task at hand. 
XML design and technologies for configuration and run-time messaging, including schema and transforms.

positions.title: Estimator
positions.description: Estimate cost of doors and door hardware for surrounding contractors.

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description:
Assisted students with computer science problems, programming languages, and object-oriented programming.
Aided other students with their academic and personal growth.
Taught skills to improve academic performance, study strategies, and note-taking skills.

positions.title: Infantry Soldier
positions.description:
Tracked and filed hundreds of administrative and personnel folders.
Reviewed disciplinary and other adverse actions and made recommendations.
Led fire team during infantry dismounted battle drills and situational training exercises.
